title: Australians are paying ‘extreme’ specialist fees. Here’s how the government can rein in costs
paragraphs: Seeing a specialist keeps getting more expensive, and a new Grattan Institute analysis shows the problem is getting worse, not better.
After years of inaction, reform may finally be on the agenda.

At the end of last year, Health Minister Mark Butler said fees to see medical specialists – such as paediatricians, dermatologists and psychiatrists – were “out of control”. The government has launched a parliamentary inquiry, and the federal health department has consulted on a range of reform options.
